7895.title: Blocking Claude SDK notices disappear from normal history
7895.rootCauseOneLine: Blocking informational SDK notices fall through to hidden diagnostics, and success results ignore the execution-stop signal.
7895.proposedFix: Translate validated blocking informational notices into existing visible errors and remember the block when settling the result, preserving token accounting and next-turn recovery.
7895.caveats: Reproduced twice at the real provider translation boundary, not through a live hook or desktop app. Six unrelated full-suite bridge failures also occur on the trusted baseline. The complete reproducer and output are inline in the HTML report.
